sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Spend Hope to add an advantage die to another PC's roll.
When: Use when the helper can describe real help in the fiction.
Not When: Do not use if the helper cannot plausibly affect the action.
Answer: Spend Hope, describe the help, and add the help die.
Example: Khari braces the rope while another PC climbs.
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
